items.label: Practical & Affordable Unlocked Phone for Daily Use
items.value: This budget-friendly unlocked android phone is built as a simple and reliable daily communication tool, not a high-end flagship. As a cost-effective option among unlocked phones, this android phone unlocked performs steadily for calling, texting and light app use, making it perfect for seniors, teenagers or as a backup unlocked cell phone that focuses only on essential daily functions without unnecessary high-end specs

items.label: Stable Performance & Flexible Storage for Everyday Tasks
items.value: Powered by an octa-core processor with 3GB+3GB virtual expandable RAM, this unlocked cell phone keeps daily apps running smoothly for regular light use only, without aiming at heavy games or high-load software. The 16GB internal storage supports up to 512GB TF card expansion, letting this android phone unlocked store daily photos, music and apps easily as a practical and dependable unlocked phone for simple daily needs

items.label: Comfortable Viewing & Handheld Experience in One
items.value: This smooth android phone combines a 6.6-inch HD+ waterdrop display with a slim, lightweight body and matte back design for an all-around comfortable experience. Running on Android 12 system, this unlocked android phones delivers clear and gentle visuals for daily browsing and reading, while the compact build ensures a secure and easy grip, making it a user-friendly cell phone for long-time daily use

items.label: Simple Camera & Long-Lasting Daily Usage
items.value: This practical unlocked android phone features a 13MP rear camera and 5MP front camera to capture casual daily moments and basic selfies, designed for daily life recording rather than professional-level photography. It supports stable and long-time daily use to keep you connected and document simple life scenes, serving as a straightforward and reliable android phone for users who value practicality over high-end functions

items.label: Important Compatibility & Safe Usage Notes
items.value: Please check before purchase: this unlocked cell phone supports only T - Mobile SIM cards, and is not compatible with 5G, e-SIM, MVNO or other carrier networks. For better durability, charge this android phone for at least 30 minutes before first use, avoid high temperatures and do not use while charging, ensuring this unlocked android phone stays in stable and safe condition for long-term daily use

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: NO SIM Cards, NO TF Cards
